v1.feedback: The piece attempts 'barcarolle' (Venetian gondola song) via wake trails, but fails the mutation brief—this is a fresh start, not parent 2g1 morphed toward the word's vibe. The wake geometry builder generates parametric S-curves that could read as water, but the 7-wake radial arrangement feels arbitrary rather than flowing. The palette (indigo/silver/lampGold) is restrained and appropriate for nocturnal Venice, but the form occupies maybe 15% of frame at default camera with sparse 80k particles across 7 separate wakes—should consolidate into denser trails or fewer, thicker ribbons that fill more viewport and actually show liquid calligraphy.

v2.feedback: Strong execution of barcarolle → water-borne procession. The leaf geometry builder and wake particles genuinely morph the parent concept into floating-leaf vignette with restrained ochre/indigo palette. Camera framing could be tighter (leaves occupy ~15% at default) — reduce wake particle budget and bring camera Z closer to 6-7 for better occupancy. The drift animation earns its compute but the reveal animation ('uncurl from upstream') feels generic; tie it more explicitly to Venetian gondola rhythm (periodic impulse in drift rather than linear).
